en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a street and courtyard leading to an arched gate with the tall bell tower of La Giralda rising behind it. On the left are multi‑story buildings with striped awnings and balconies; a man stands with a donkey on the sidewalk. On the right is a line of trees bordering the open plaza. Handwritten Spanish text is scrawled across the lower half. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as the Alcázar's Patio de las Banderas in Sevilla.
